answer: By the harbor of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The plume lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the haven is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, published publicly on failure, rewards vest against future work. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
